row.team_price_text: Forms: $83/mo flat, paid annually (1 builder user, 25 forms)
row.evidence: Formstack's developer docs publish a SCIM 2.0 API ("SCIM can be implemented to sync users and groups between your service and Formstack", authenticated with a SCIM Token), but neither the pricing page nor the docs say which plan includes it; the pricing page lists SSO only under Enterprise Solutions.
row.notes: Status changed from gated (June) to unknown: June's 'SCIM on Enterprise (Salesforce Solutions and Enterprise per docs)' has no current first-party source. Formstack's help centre has no SCIM article, the developer SCIM reference states no plan, and the pricing page does not mention SCIM. Pricing is flat by builder seats: Forms $83/mo and Suite $250/mo paid annually ($99 / $299 monthly), Salesforce Solutions and Enterprise Solutions custom; SSO and 'API Access and custom integrations' are listed on Enterprise Solutions. A separate User Management API (users, groups, audit logs) is documented on api-us.streamline.intellistack.ai.

plans.name: Forms
plans.price_text: $83/month paid annually ($99 monthly); 1 builder user, 25 forms

plans.name: Suite
plans.price_text: $250/month paid annually ($299 monthly); 3 builder users, 100 forms

auth.token_source: Profile menu > API (https://www.formstack.com/admin/apiKey/main) > SCIM Tokens > add a new SCIM Token

operations.notes: PATCH Users only supports add/remove ops (form/folder permissions); active attribute exists in the User model but deactivate behaviour is not described.

deprovision.data_retained: Manual user removal keeps forms and document templates, reassigning authorship to the account administrator (SCIM DELETE behaviour not described).

custom.how: Formstack extension urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:formstack:2.0:User: canCreateForms, canCreateThemes, folders, forms, isAdmin, isParticipantUser, mustLoginUsingSso

roles.how: Formstack extension attributes isAdmin, canCreateForms, canCreateThemes and per-form/folder permissions.

limitations.text: Only userName eq filtering is supported.
Not listed in the Okta Integration Network as a SCIM app (SWA only); no IdP-specific SCIM guides are published.

auth.notes: Forms API V2025 uses Personal Access Tokens (Bearer fs_pat_); the older v2 API uses OAuth2.

rate_limits.text: Forms API V2025: daily per-token limits that vary by plan; 429 when exceeded

limitations.text: The User Management API is served from api-us/api-ca.streamline.intellistack.ai; which Formstack plans can use it is not stated.

entra.notes: Formstack's guide uses the generic Microsoft Entra SAML Toolkit gallery app; Microsoft Learn has no Formstack tutorial (404).

onelogin.notes: From Formstack's own OneLogin SAML guide.

fallbacks.notes: SSO providers can be SAML or OpenID Connect; JIT ('Enable user creation via SSO') only for org-owned providers.

open_questions: Which plan includes SCIM (and the SCIM Token page) is not stated anywhere public; June's Enterprise gate could not be re-sourced.
Whether SCIM requires SSO is not stated.
What SCIM DELETE or active=false does (deactivate vs remove, seat release, sessions) is not documented.
No IdP-specific SCIM guides (Okta, Entra, OneLogin, Google, JumpCloud) were found; Okta lists Formstack as SWA only.
Whether the Formstack pricing page's 'API Access and custom integrations' (Enterprise) means the API is gated is unclear; plans for the V2025 API and the User Management API are not stated.
SSO availability on Forms and Suite plans is not stated on the pricing page (rendered comparison table could not be loaded: headless renderer failed with ERR_TOO_MANY_RETRIES).
SCIM rate limits, ServiceProviderConfig and Schemas endpoints are not documented.
